correctness.rationale: For m=2^k+1 odd, low-bit multiplication with carry c yields next d=floor((c+mb)/2), sign factor (-1)^c independent of chosen input bit b, hence row transition M_{c,d}=(-1)^c(sum indicators). After j<=k digits the low and shifted copies do not overlap and R_j=sum_{a<2^j}e_{a2^{k-j}}. Summing parity-cancelled endpoints gives R_{k+1}=e_{2^{k-1}}-e_{2^k}, next row explicit, and exact row equality R_{k+2}-R_{k+1}-R2+3R1-2R0=0 for all k>=2. Multiply by M^r and final carry vector tau(c) to obtain unrestricted recurrence; initial 1, k+1 zeros, 2 give displayed rational GF. Independently checked exact row relation k=2..8 and 70 direct finite dyadic sums. k=1 excluded; r=0 included; sums are ordinary integers.
residual_risks: Bounded independent tests corroborate but do not themselves prove the infinite-parameter theorem.
